title: The Pantry of Whispers
intro: Shelves of dusty jars line the walls and every one of them seems to whisper. A small iron safe is bolted behind the biggest shelf.

objects.label: Whispering Barrel
objects.reward_text: The barrel stops whispering and a voice says one number: 8.

objects.label: Hanging Ham
objects.reward_text: The ham swings round and the face carved into it grins at you.

a_jar: Look at the differences between neighbouring numbers.
The differences are 2, 4, 8, 16. Each is a multiple of the one before.
The differences are multiplied by 2 each time, so the next difference is 32.
b_barrel: This is a quick quiz of five reasoning questions. Read each one calmly.
You need 3 of the 5 right. The server keeps the clock, so do not dawdle.
If you fail you can try again with a fresh set of questions.
Answer the five questions and the reward shows a clue number. The vault's character number 2 is 6.
c_sack: Open your clue notes: you need the number from the Pickling Jar and the number from the Whispering Barrel.
Multiply the two numbers, then add each of them once.
40 + 5 + 8 = 53. The vault's characters number 3 and 4 are F and 2.
vault: The code has four characters. Some are letters, some are digits.
Each solved object revealed part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: Pickling Jar, Whispering Barrel, Flour Sack.
